language.name: English
item.potion.name: Potion
item.potion.lore: A cloudy tonic distilled from what the Vast leaves behind. Travelers swear it tastes like the memory of rain.
item.antidote.name: Antidote
item.antidote.lore: Bitter and pale. Whoever brewed the first batch had lost someone to the creeping rot, and never wrote down who.
item.cohesion_shard.name: Cohesion Shard
item.cohesion_shard.lore: A sliver that hums when held. It remembers being whole, and lends a little of that certainty to whoever will take it.
item.group_tonic.name: Group Tonic
item.group_tonic.lore: Brewed in a pot large enough to feed a camp. It is shared, never hoarded; the old folk say it tastes better that way.
item.ring_vitality.name: Ring of Vitality
item.ring_vitality.lore: Worn smooth by a hand that is no longer there. The band is warm, as if someone had only just taken it off.
item.ring_vigor.name: Ring of Vigor
item.ring_vigor.lore: Its owner refused to rest, and the ring complied. It never asked what came after.
item.amulet_cohesion.name: Cohesion Amulet
item.amulet_cohesion.lore: A knot of thread and bone, pulled tight. Those who wear it say they feel less likely to come undone.
item.key_rusty.name: Rusty Key
item.key_rusty.lore: The rust has eaten the teeth, yet the lock still yields to it. Something below the cellar is waiting to be opened.
enemy.training_dummy.name: Training Dummy
item.ether.name: Ether
item.ether.lore: Blue and cold, it sloshes like a trapped sky. Mages say it tastes of thunder that never arrived.
item.ember_ring.name: Ember Ring
item.ember_ring.lore: A ring that never cools. Whoever wears it leaves faint scorch marks on everything they hold dear.
item.iron_sword.name: Iron Sword
item.iron_sword.lore: Plain, heavy, and honest. The notches along the blade are a diary no one asked to read.
item.flame_brand.name: Flame Brand
item.flame_brand.lore: Quenched in something that was not water. The edge still glows when it remembers who it was forged to hurt.
item.apprentice_staff.name: Apprentice Staff
item.apprentice_staff.lore: Carved from a branch that fell by itself. It hums softly, eager to be taught a better spell.
item.iron_mail.name: Iron Mail
item.iron_mail.lore: Heavy links, patched a dozen times by different hands. Every patch is a different owner's last good idea.
item.wayfarer_pendant.name: Wayfarer Pendant
item.wayfarer_pendant.lore: Strung from whatever the road offered: a tooth, a coin, a knot of hair. Each piece pulls a little in its own direction.
item.excalibur.name: Excalibur
item.excalibur.lore: They say it was never forged, only remembered. Whoever draws it feels the whole world lean in to see if they are worthy.
